system.description: Armor Class: 7 Hit Dice: 1 (M) Move: 60' (20') Attacks: 1 Damage: By weapon No. Appearing: 3d4 (3d10) Save As: Fl Morale: 12 Treasure Type: Nil Intelligence: 1 Alignment: Chaotic XP Value: 10 Monster Type: Undead, Enchanted (Common). Animated skeletons are undead creatures often used as guards by the high level magic-user or cleric who animated them, or by greater undead creatures who command them. Skeletons are often found near graveyards, dungeons, and other deserted places.
